name: apple_mail_list_accounts
description: Read-only: list local Apple Mail account names, sender addresses, and mailbox names. Use this before other Mail tools when the exact names are unknown.

name: apple_mail_list
description: Read-only: list local Apple Mail metadata. Returns message ID, sender, subject, received time, and read/flag status. It does not read message bodies.

name: apple_mail_get
description: Read-only: read one local Apple Mail message, including its body. Use apple_mail_list first to obtain the local mail id.

mailId.description: Local Mail message id returned by apple_mail_list.

name: apple_mail_send
description: Send an Apple Mail message from the selected local account. This immediately sends email to the specified recipients.

name: apple_mail_update_status
description: Modify a local Apple Mail message read/unread and/or flagged status.

mailId.description: Local Mail message id returned by apple_mail_list.

name: apple_mail_move
description: Move a local Apple Mail message to another mailbox in the same account.

mailId.description: Local Mail message id returned by apple_mail_list.

name: apple_mail_delete
description: Delete a local Apple Mail message. This is destructive and moves the message according to Mail.app deletion behavior.

mailId.description: Local Mail message id returned by apple_mail_list.

name: apple_calendar_list_calendars
description: Read-only: list local Calendar.app calendar names and whether each calendar is writable. Use this before creating or modifying events when the exact calendar name is unknown.

name: apple_calendar_list_events
description: Read-only: list local Calendar.app events in a time range.

end.description: Inclusive ISO 8601 end date/time; must be after start.

calendars.description: Optional calendar-name allowlist. Empty means all calendars.

name: apple_calendar_create_event
description: Create a new local Calendar.app event.

name: apple_calendar_update_event
description: Modify an existing local Calendar.app event. Obtain the uid from apple_calendar_list_events.

name: apple_calendar_delete_event
description: Delete an existing local Calendar.app event. This is destructive.

name: apple_reminders_list_lists
description: Read-only: list local Apple Reminders list names and IDs. Use this before creating reminders when the exact list name is unknown.

name: apple_reminders_list
description: Read-only: list local Apple Reminders.

lists.description: Optional reminder-list allowlist. Empty means all lists.

name: apple_reminders_create
description: Create a local Apple Reminder.

name: apple_reminders_update
description: Modify an existing local Apple Reminder.

name: apple_reminders_complete
description: Mark an existing local Apple Reminder as completed.

name: apple_reminders_delete
description: Delete an existing local Apple Reminder. This is destructive.

name: apple_reminders_list_accounts
description: Read-only: list Reminders account IDs and names.

name: apple_reminders_create_list
description: Create a Reminders list in an exact account ID.

name: apple_reminders_rename_list
description: Rename a Reminders list by ID.

name: apple_reminders_delete_list
description: Delete a Reminders list and its reminders. Destructive; may sync to iCloud.

name: apple_reminders_get
description: Read-only: get reminder notes, completion, due time, alarm, priority, and flag.

name: apple_reminders_search
description: Read-only: search reminder titles within selected lists.

name: apple_reminders_set_completed
description: Set a reminder completion state, including reopening a completed reminder.

name: apple_reminders_set_flagged
description: Set or clear a reminder flag.

name: apple_reminders_set_alarm
description: Set or clear a reminder notification date.

name: apple_calendar_create_calendar
description: Create a Calendar.app calendar using the app default account.

name: apple_calendar_rename_calendar
description: Rename a uniquely named writable calendar.

name: apple_calendar_delete_calendar
description: Delete a uniquely named writable calendar and all its events. Destructive.

name: apple_calendar_get_event
description: Read-only: get event notes, recurrence, URL, attendees, and display alarms.

name: apple_calendar_add_alarm
description: Add a display alarm to an event. Negative minutes means before the event.

name: apple_calendar_set_recurrence
description: Set an event recurrence rule (for example FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=5); empty string clears recurrence. Calendar validates the rule.

name: apple_calendar_set_url
description: Set or clear an event HTTP/HTTPS URL.

name: apple_mail_search
description: Read-only: search a mailbox by subject or sender; returns bounded metadata without bodies.

name: apple_mail_create_draft
description: Create a visible outgoing Mail draft. Does not send; Mail controls draft persistence.

name: apple_mail_create_mailbox
description: Create a mailbox in the selected Mail account.

name: apple_mail_list_attachments
description: Read-only: list attachment metadata for one message.

name: apple_mail_save_attachment
description: Save one attachment to a new file under APPLE_MCP_FILE_ROOTS. Existing paths are refused.

name: apple_pages_list_documents
description: List open Pages documents. Does not launch a stopped application.

name: apple_pages_open
description: Open a local Pages document. Launches the app and may show its window or import dialogs.

name: apple_pages_create
description: Create an unsaved Pages document. May show a window. Use the returned name for subsequent operations; save explicitly.

text.description: Optional initial body text; omitting preserves the selected template body.

name: apple_pages_save
description: Save Pages to a .pages path with an existing parent directory. Existing paths, including the current document path, require overwrite:true. TextEdit saves RTF; no implicit format conversion.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_pages_close
description: Close one Pages document. Refuses unsaved changes or a document without a saved path unless discardChanges:true; save separately to retain changes.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_pages_export
description: Export Pages to PDF or its supported Microsoft Office format. Requires an existing parent directory; existing destinations require overwrite:true. Large exports may exceed the automation timeout.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_pages_read_text
description: Read Pages plain text with character pagination. Pages supports word-processing body text only; rich formatting and text boxes are not returned.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_pages_set_text
description: Replace or append Pages plain text. This can remove existing rich formatting; changes may autosave and sync. Pages requires a word-processing document.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_list_documents
description: List open Numbers documents. Does not launch a stopped application.

name: apple_numbers_open
description: Open a local Numbers document. Launches the app and may show its window or import dialogs.

name: apple_numbers_create
description: Create an unsaved Numbers document. May show a window. Use the returned name for subsequent operations; save explicitly.

name: apple_numbers_save
description: Save Numbers to a .numbers path with an existing parent directory. Existing paths, including the current document path, require overwrite:true. TextEdit saves RTF; no implicit format conversion.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_close
description: Close one Numbers document. Refuses unsaved changes or a document without a saved path unless discardChanges:true; save separately to retain changes.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_export
description: Export Numbers to PDF or its supported Microsoft Office format. Requires an existing parent directory; existing destinations require overwrite:true. Large exports may exceed the automation timeout.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_keynote_list_documents
description: List open Keynote documents. Does not launch a stopped application.

name: apple_keynote_open
description: Open a local Keynote document. Launches the app and may show its window or import dialogs.

name: apple_keynote_create
description: Create an unsaved Keynote document. May show a window. Use the returned name for subsequent operations; save explicitly.

name: apple_keynote_save
description: Save Keynote to a .key path with an existing parent directory. Existing paths, including the current document path, require overwrite:true. TextEdit saves RTF; no implicit format conversion.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_keynote_close
description: Close one Keynote document. Refuses unsaved changes or a document without a saved path unless discardChanges:true; save separately to retain changes.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_keynote_export
description: Export Keynote to PDF or its supported Microsoft Office format. Requires an existing parent directory; existing destinations require overwrite:true. Large exports may exceed the automation timeout.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_textedit_list_documents
description: List open TextEdit documents. Does not launch a stopped application.

name: apple_textedit_open
description: Open a local TextEdit document. Launches the app and may show its window or import dialogs.

name: apple_textedit_create
description: Create an unsaved TextEdit document. May show a window. Use the returned name for subsequent operations; save explicitly.

name: apple_textedit_save
description: Save TextEdit to a .rtf path with an existing parent directory. Existing paths, including the current document path, require overwrite:true. TextEdit saves RTF; no implicit format conversion.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_textedit_close
description: Close one TextEdit document. Refuses unsaved changes or a document without a saved path unless discardChanges:true; save separately to retain changes.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_textedit_read_text
description: Read TextEdit plain text with character pagination. Pages supports word-processing body text only; rich formatting and text boxes are not returned.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_textedit_set_text
description: Replace or append TextEdit plain text. This can remove existing rich formatting; changes may autosave and sync. Pages requires a word-processing document.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_list_sheets
description: List sheets in an open Numbers spreadsheet.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_list_tables
description: List table names and dimensions in a Numbers sheet.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_create_table
description: Add a named table without header or footer rows to a Numbers sheet. Rejects duplicate table names.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_read_range
description: Read values, formatted text and formulas from a rectangular Numbers range, using 1-based row and column indexes. Maximum 200 cells; strings are truncated to 500 characters per field.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_numbers_write_range
description: Write a rectangular grid to existing Numbers cells using 1-based indexes. null clears a cell. Formula strings require allowFormulas:true. Bounds are checked before writing; an application failure may leave partial changes. May autosave and sync.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_keynote_list_slides
description: Read slide indexes, default title/body text, presenter notes and skipped status. Does not extract other text boxes, charts, images, or media. Returned text is bounded.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_keynote_add_slide
description: Append a Keynote slide, optionally using an exact master-slide layout name, and set its default title/body, presenter notes and skipped status. Changes may autosave and sync.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_keynote_update_slide
description: Update default title/body, presenter notes or skipped status of a Keynote slide using its current 1-based index. List slides immediately before modifying; changes may autosave and sync.

documentName.description: Exact name returned by list_documents; ambiguous duplicate names are rejected.

name: apple_notes_list_accounts
description: Read-only: list Notes account IDs and names.

name: apple_notes_list_folders
description: Read-only: list Notes folder IDs and names, optionally within one account.

name: apple_notes_list
description: Read-only: list note metadata without reading note bodies, optionally within a folder.

name: apple_notes_search
description: Read-only: find Notes by title substring; this does not search note bodies.

name: apple_notes_get
description: Read-only: get note metadata and bounded plain text or HTML. Locked notes return metadata only.

name: apple_notes_create
description: Create a note in an explicit folder, with an escaped title heading and optional HTML body. May sync to iCloud.

name: apple_notes_update
description: Change a note title and/or replace its entire HTML body. Replacing the body can remove formatting or attachments; locked notes are rejected.

name: apple_notes_delete
description: Delete an unlocked note using Notes deletion behavior. May sync deletion to other devices.

name: apple_notes_create_folder
description: Create a top-level Notes folder in an explicit account.

name: apple_contacts_search
description: Read-only: find contacts by name or organization substring. Returns summaries, not all contact details.

name: apple_contacts_get
description: Read-only: get one contact with names, organization, emails, phones, and bounded notes.

name: apple_contacts_list_groups
description: Read-only: list Contacts groups.

name: apple_contacts_list_group_members
description: Read-only: list summaries of people in one Contacts group.

name: apple_contacts_create
description: Create and save a contact, optionally with labeled emails and phone numbers. Refuses to run while Contacts has unsaved edits.

name: apple_contacts_update
description: Update and save selected name, organization, job title, or note fields. Leaves phone and email collections unchanged. Refuses pending unsaved Contacts edits.

name: apple_contacts_create_group
description: Create and save a Contacts group. Refuses pending unsaved Contacts edits.

name: apple_contacts_add_to_group
description: Add an existing contact to a group and save Contacts changes.

name: apple_contacts_remove_from_group
description: Remove a contact from a group without deleting the contact; saves Contacts changes.

name: apple_safari_list_tabs
description: Read-only: list Safari tab titles, URLs, window IDs, and one-based tab indices. Tab indices change when tabs close.

name: apple_safari_get_tab
description: Read-only: read one Safari tab title and URL, with optional bounded page text using Safari scripting. Does not execute page JavaScript.

name: apple_safari_open_tab
description: Open an HTTP(S) URL in a new Safari tab. This loads the URL and can contact a remote website.

name: apple_safari_navigate_tab
description: Navigate one Safari tab to an HTTP(S) URL. Requires its previously observed URL to avoid modifying a different tab after indices shift.

name: apple_safari_close_tab
description: Close a Safari tab; unsaved page input may be lost. Requires its previously observed URL.

name: apple_safari_add_reading_list
description: Add an HTTP(S) URL, optional title, and preview to Safari Reading List; may sync through iCloud.

name: apple_music_list_playlists
description: Read-only: list Music playlist persistent IDs, names, and kinds.

name: apple_music_list_tracks
description: Read-only: list Music library or playlist track metadata; IDs are persistent hexadecimal IDs.

name: apple_music_search
description: Read-only: search an explicit Music playlist. Use list_playlists to identify the library playlist.

name: apple_music_get_track
description: Read-only: get one Music library track by persistent ID.

name: apple_music_get_playback_state
description: Read-only: get Music playback state, volume, position, and current track when playing or paused.

name: apple_music_playback
description: Control Music playback: play/resume, pause, stop, next, or previous. Play optionally targets one track or playlist. Playback can stream audio.

name: apple_music_set_volume
description: Set Music playback volume from 0 to 100.

name: apple_music_create_playlist
description: Create a new user playlist in Music. May sync through the music library.

name: apple_music_add_tracks_to_playlist
description: Copy existing library tracks into a regular user playlist. Rejects smart and special playlists. Repeating may add duplicates.

name: apple_photos_list_albums
description: Read-only: list Photos album IDs and names.

name: apple_photos_list
description: Read-only: list Photos library or album media metadata without exporting image data.

name: apple_photos_search
description: Read-only: search Photos using its native search command; returns bounded metadata results.

name: apple_photos_get
description: Read-only: get one Photos media item with metadata, keywords, and bounded description.

name: apple_photos_create_album
description: Create a new top-level Photos album.

name: apple_photos_add_to_album
description: Add existing Photos media items to an album. Does not import or delete files.

name: apple_photos_import
description: Import existing local files into Photos, optionally into an album. Duplicate checking remains enabled; imported media may upload to iCloud Photos.

name: apple_photos_export
description: Export selected Photos media into an existing empty local directory. Requires an empty directory to reduce overwrite risk; originals can trigger iCloud downloads. Exports originals or rendered JPEGs.

name: apple_photos_update
description: Update a Photos media title, description, favorite flag, and/or replace its keyword list. May sync through iCloud Photos.

name: apple_messages_list_accounts
description: Read-only: list Messages accounts (also called services), IDs, service types, and connection states. serviceType is null if macOS does not expose it.

name: apple_messages_list_chats
description: Read-only: list Messages chat metadata and participant handles. Apple scripting does not expose message history.

name: apple_messages_send
description: Immediately send text to one explicit phone number or email through a selected connected Messages account. This is a real outgoing message; success means submitted, not delivered.

name: apple_system_capabilities
description: Read-only: discover installed Apple apps, platform, file roots, and allowed Shortcuts. Does not test Automation permission.

name: apple_system_open_app
description: Launch or activate a supported Apple app.

name: apple_files_list
description: Read-only: list one allowed folder. Bounded, non-recursive; hidden entries excluded by default.

name: apple_files_info
description: Read-only: file/folder metadata within allowed roots.

name: apple_files_read_text
description: Read-only: read bounded UTF-8 text from an allowed regular file. Does not parse Pages, PDF, or other binary formats.

name: apple_files_write_text
description: Create a UTF-8 file in an allowed folder. Existing files require overwrite=true.

name: apple_files_create_folder
description: Create one new folder under an existing allowed folder.

name: apple_files_copy
description: Copy one regular file within allowed roots. Never overwrites a destination.

name: apple_files_search
description: Read-only: Spotlight filename search within one allowed folder. Results depend on local Spotlight indexing.

name: apple_files_trash
description: Move an allowed file or folder to Finder Trash. Symbolic links are refused to avoid deleting their targets. May sync deletions through iCloud. Never empties Trash.

name: apple_finder_reveal
description: Reveal an allowed file or folder in Finder.

name: apple_finder_selection
description: Read-only: get selected Finder items (names and URLs). Does not read contents.

name: apple_shortcuts_list
description: Read-only: list installed Shortcuts, optionally in one folder.

name: apple_shortcuts_list_folders
description: Read-only: list Shortcuts folders.

name: apple_shortcuts_run
description: Run an explicitly allowlisted shortcut. It can modify files, send messages, or control other apps; inspect the shortcut before allowing it. Timeout does not guarantee its effects stop.
